Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to the Redwood POC. We want Day 0 to be very practical: a short kickoff, then a focused hands-on working session where we pair on your core prompts, routing policies, and run a small-scale load test to validate latency and KV/cache behavior.

Proposed Day 0 agenda (60–90m):
- 10m: Quick intro & success criteria align
- 25m: Prompt library walkthrough + prompt-editing best practices
- 25m: Routing & model-variant decisions (latency vs. quality)
- 20m: Mini load test plan + how we'll measure (throughput, p95 latency, token cost)

Please send two 90-minute windows that work for your engineering lead. We have internal availability: Mon 3/22 09:30–11:00 PT, Tue 3/23 13:00–14:30 PT. If neither works, we can reschedule.

Attachments: day0-agenda.pdf (PDF agenda draft)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Soojin Lee

Subject: Day 0 recap & action items — next steps and scheduling follow-up

Samir / team — thanks for today's session — great energy and focused feedback. Below is a concise recap and owners.

Recap (short):
- Kickoff: aligned on success criteria (p95 < 300ms for 1k concurrent simulated users, safe prompt outputs for billing flows).
- Prompt review: iterated on billing_prompt_v2 — removed open-ended ask, added explicit slot for account_id, added negative examples. See prompts-v0.3.md in Drive.
- Routing decisions: agreed on primary low-latency variant (quantized medium) with fallback to higher-fidelity model for ambiguous intents. Karthik documented routing tiers and policy in the Drive link.
- Load tests: Dev ran baseline + two bursts per the loadtest-matrix.xlsx; observed p95 = 280ms on baseline, 420ms on 10-minute burst (under current staging VM sizes).

Action items (owner — due):
- NovaCorp: provide a 24-hour dump of anonymized session logs for prompt tuning — Samir (due 2027-03-25)
- Redwood: produce a short runbook for the routing fallback and how to adjust thresholds — Karthik Iyer (due 2027-03-24)
- Redwood: tune quantization profile and re-run the 10-min burst in a larger staging instance to target p95 < 300ms — Dev Patel (due 2027-03-29)
- Both: schedule follow-up deep-dive on prompt tuning and metric baselining (60m) — proposed slots below.

Proposed follow-up slots (60m):
- Tue 3/30 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 3/31 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu 4/01 13:00–14:00 PT

Please reply with preferred slot or send an invite. I've attached the artifacts we used.

Attachments: prompts-v0.3.md, loadtest-matrix.xlsx
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/89012

Thanks again — great work today.

— Soojin Lee
